author: Xufen Tu
title: 可以陪一个人走慢一点，但不能陪他停在原地
observation: Affection and love can be cultivated, but long-term one-sided help becomes exhausting when the other person refuses to listen, change, or move forward.
current_judgment: A person can support someone who is willing to grow, but should not carry responsibility for someone who persistently refuses to act.
boundary: Helping another person should not become long-term substitution for that person's own judgment, growth, or responsibility.
